description: Get the price of a selection: use this whenever someone asks what data would cost, the total for several products, the price with building geometry added, or the price at a licence tier for their use, instead of reading list prices from a product card. Price catalog products (items: sku from search or fetch, licence, optional building geometry) or one custom cut, such as chosen brands in chosen states (cut plus the full_cut_hash from mogean_count, and a licence). Prices are computed by the store and equal the product page; one-time prices at the internal or embedded licence only. A priced quote returns the total and can carry a quote_id that holds the price for up to 30 minutes.

cut.description: A custom cut: every non-empty list narrows the selection.

brands.description: Brands: ids from search (brand:<slug>) or bare slugs (fetch metadata.key).

categories.description: Categories: ids from search (category:<slug>) or bare slugs (fetch metadata.key).

columns.description: Column names to deliver; empty means every column.

gov_sources.description: Government sources: ids from search (gov:<slug>) or bare slugs (fetch metadata.key).

leaf_categories.description: Leaf categories: slugs from fetch (metadata.category.leaf_slug), or a leaf name fetch shows when it names one leaf.

states.description: States: two-letter US codes, or ids from search (state:TX).

tiers.description: Provenance tier groups: pipeline, government, fsq, overture. PIPELINE_AUTHORITATIVE, GOVERNMENT_AUTHORITATIVE and OVERTURE_SUPPLEMENT (as by_tier names them) select their group; the three FSQ_ tiers are selected together as fsq.

full_cut_hash.description: With cut: the full_cut_hash mogean_count returned for this exact cut.

intended_use.description: Optional: what the data is for. It never changes the price; where licence guidance is available the result names the licence tier that use needs.

note.description: Free text; not stored or repeated.

items.description: Catalog products to price together, each with its licence tier; the result totals them (send items or cut, not both).

geometry_add_on.description: Add the building-geometry file where the product offers it; the quote prices it in.

license.description: Licence tier. Agents can quote internal and embedded; redistribution is handled on the Mogean store or by Mogean sales.

sku.description: A sku from search or fetch.

license.description: With cut: the licence tier to price the cut at.

response_format.description: concise (default) returns a short summary; detailed adds the full structured result as text.

name: mogean_quote

cart_eligibility.description: Whether this quote fits the fixed limits of one agent cart: at most max_cart_lines lines and, when max_cart_total_usd is present, at most that total (no total limit when it is absent). A quote above either never can. eligible: true is not a promise: creating the cart makes the final check, which also counts any monthly limit on the account and the lines of any other quotes in the same cart.

invoice_note.description: Present only when the quote is $5,000 or more and fits one agent cart: the invoice alternative to card, as the cart carries it.

priced_rows.description: Cut lines: the rows the per-row formula prices. Lower than rows when a brand-only cut includes in-store department rows, which ship at no charge. When published_price_applied is true, the price is the published product price instead.

rows.description: Cut lines: the rows the cut's files contain.

store_next_steps.description: What the buyer does on the Mogean store to complete this; an agent cannot. Relay `relay` and the ordered `steps` with the `where` link.

send_to_sales.description: For a custom cut Mogean sales handles: what the buyer sends them, the cut, in the same shape as the cut input, and its full_cut_hash, and the licence and term asked for.

title: Quote a price
